limitations: CAP-INV-101 implementation is only the bounded, immutable, provider-neutral, read-only Case Queue runtime; full capability completion is not claimed.
OPEN-013 prevents Case create/update/assignment/status/lifecycle operations delegated to CAP-INV-102.
Saved View create/update/share/archive/manage remain Shared-owned and are excluded.
Export Job creation, export backend and report rendering are excluded.
Incident is Command-owned optional context; Task, Decision, Response Run and Command Work Queue remain excluded.
Final queue columns, final Case state machine, final dedicated UI, persistence/provider, collaboration, retention and production SLO remain unselected.
The return token is untrusted presentation state, not a signed, encrypted or authorization-bearing credential.
next_conditions: Retain explicit tenant and Case-read access evaluation at every runtime boundary.

Resolve OPEN-013 before Case assignment, lifecycle, update or status mutation.
Keep foreign-owned Incident, Saved View, Task, Decision and Response Run ownership separate.
Do not infer the final UI, storage, provider, export backend, or production SLO from the bounded runtime.
Implementation ledger may use only a VERIFIED E10-INV-101F handoff after successful GitHub Actions on its source head.
